claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 uM the compound most plausibly kills cells through a broad, non-selective cytotoxic effect driven by its physicochemical properties (cationic amphiphilic lysosomal stress) rather than by GSK3 inhibition, since GSK3 inhibitors are not broadly cytotoxic at this concentration.
